description: macOS-style Windows Dynamic Island with media controls, notifications, microphone indicators, window shelf, virtual-desktop support, and per-monitor islands.
pre_uninstall: catch { Write-Warning "Dynamic Island cleanup command '$argument' failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
Write-Host 'Restored the original EnableSnapBar value captured before Dynamic Island first ran.'
Write-Host 'Restored the original default EnableSnapBar state (the value was absent before installation).'
Write-Warning 'No original EnableSnapBar value was captured by Scoop. The current 0 value was preserved rather than deleting a possibly pre-existing user setting.'
Write-Host 'EnableSnapBar no longer equals the value set by Dynamic Island; preserving the user change.'
Write-Warning 'The DynamicIsland scheduled task still exists. Its registry state was preserved; remove the task from Task Scheduler if it was not removed after the elevation prompt.'
Write-Warning 'Notification banner backup data remains under HKCU:\Software\DynamicIsland\HiddenBanners and was preserved so it can still be restored.'
notes: The official v0.8.0 release is an Inno Setup installer. The upstream installer/DynamicIsland.iss defines DynamicIsland.exe as the app executable and packages the contents of the self-contained publish directory directly under {app}; Scoop uses innosetup=true to extract that payload without executing the vendor's installation, registry, startup, or uninstall sections.

This application is classified Nonportable because its own startup code applies Windows integration: on Windows 11 build 22621 or later it sets HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\EnableSnapBar to 0 and restarts Explorer once. Its default notification settings also hide native Windows notification banners while the island is running and restore them on normal exit. The app stores data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\DynamicIsland.

pre_install captures the existing EnableSnapBar value before the app first runs. pre_uninstall requests a clean app exit, removes the app's optional scheduled startup task, restores notification banners, and restores the original Snap Layouts setting only when the current value is still the 0 applied by the app. If the user changed the setting afterwards, that change is preserved. For pre-existing/manual installations where Scoop has no original-value backup, the current value is preserved rather than deleted blindly. User data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\DynamicIsland is intentionally retained.
